two_outcome_mode_collapse.description: Two-outcome social-choice setting from Proposition 3.1/3.2 and the paper's 80% vs 20% example with beta=0.1.

minority_probability.description: Mass assigned to the minority-supported outcome, which catches majority-mode collapse.

majority_overweight.description: Ratio of assigned majority mass to the population majority preference, penalizing majority over-concentration.

top_choice_preserved.description: Whether the population's majority-supported option remains the top-probability option.

preference_kl.description: KL divergence from the population preference distribution to the learned policy, penalizing over-flattened shortcuts.

brier_score.description: Squared distributional error between learned probabilities and population preferences.

expected_calibration_error.description: Finite-action calibration gap between predicted probability mass and population preference mass.

population_l1_error.description: Total absolute deviation from the target population preference distribution.

tabular_preference_learning.description: Multi-outcome finite Plackett-Luce setting derived from Proposition A.1, testing SPL's generalized preference representation and best-of-N diversity implication.

preference_kl.description: KL divergence from each prompt's population preference distribution to the learned policy.

best_of_128_success_probability.description: Analytic probability that repeated sampling finds the marked useful minority-supported action.

normalized_entropy.description: Entropy normalized by action-space size, rewarding retained preference diversity.

effective_actions.description: Exponentiated entropy of the learned policy, expressed as an effective number of supported actions.

brier_score.description: Squared distributional error between learned probabilities and population preferences.

expected_calibration_error.description: Finite-action calibration gap between predicted probability mass and population preference mass.

argmax_population_mode_accuracy.description: Fraction of prompts where the learned top action matches the population mode.

expected_population_preference.description: Expected population preference of a sample drawn from the learned policy.

reference_cross_entropy.description: Cross-entropy of the learned policy under the fixed reference policy, discouraging artifacts that ignore the reference support.

empirical_best_of_128_success.description: Observed repeated-sampling success in saved samples when a method supplies sample artifacts.
